title: Openred
intro: OpenRed is a collaborative platform that allows citizens and scientists to record, visualize, and analyze environmental measurements in real time, including gamma radiation and light pollution. It is a project of the Ibercivis Foundation.

map.title: Map visualization
map.body: Explore gamma radiation and light pollution measurements on an interactive map, by campaigns and scientific missions.

data.title: Data analysis
data.body: Detailed statistics, distributions and histograms. Analyze trends and patterns in environmental measurements.

community.title: Citizen science
community.body: Contribute by recording your own measurements and become part of an open and transparent community.

app.title: Mobile application
app.body: Record measurements from your Android device and sync them automatically with the platform.
